maya_docs: Quick heads-up — I'm drafting release notes for the new Embed Streaming opt-in and a small migration guide for SDK users. There is a known issue where streaming embeddings can duplicate the final token when legacy chunking is enabled. Need someone to update the Python/TS snippets and add a short migration example. Can anyone pick this up? :memo:

kevin_sdk: I can take the SDK snippets. Where's the current example live?

kevin_sdk: Found it: https://redwood.example/docs/embeddings-streaming — I'll prepare a PR with both Python + TypeScript examples and a short note about disabling chunking.

jordan_research: FYI the dup-token happens when `chunk_size != 0` AND `stream=true`. Repro minimal log: `STREAM: chunk[...], token=".</s>" -> emitted twice at EOF when flush called`. We patched runtime to avoid double-flush for canary but docs should instruct to set `chunk_size: 0` or use the streaming helper.

sam_platform: Heads-up from infra: the canary saw a slight tail-latency bump when streaming + large batches. Not blocker, but worth calling out in the known-issues section of the relnotes. Also ensure Dedicated customers know the config difference.

alice_pm: For migration copy, can we keep it very short? "Old -> New" 3-line mapping is perfect. Eg: old `embeddings.stream()` -> new context manager `with embeddings.streaming() as s:`. Also, add a one-line explainer about why (avoids duplicate flush).

kevin_sdk: Draft snippet (will polish in PR):
```python
# legacy v0.x
resp = client.embeddings.stream(model="embed-xl", input=text)
for chunk in resp:
    process(chunk)

# recommended v0.10+
with client.embeddings.streaming(model="embed-xl", input=text) as s:
    for chunk in s:
        process(chunk)
```
I'll mirror similar for TS/JS.

maya_docs: Perfect. Please also update the short example in the "migration guide" page and add an anchored note to the top of the embeddings streaming docs that points to known issues. Also there are two broken redirects I noticed: `/docs/embed` -> 404, should redirect to `/docs/embeddings`. Can you fix links in the PR?

kevin_sdk: Yep — fixing redirects and adding an explicit "Known issue: duplicate token with legacy chunking" bullet in the relnotes draft. Opening PR now. Will ping once ready.

release-bot: docs PR 4578 opened by kevin_sdk -> https://stash.example/pulls/4578 (staging target). Checklist: run linkchecker, run snippet linter, update relnotes draft. :gear:

sam_platform: I'll run the linkchecker and snippet linter after the PR is merged to staging. If all green, I'll tag the relnotes as "ready-to-publish".

kevin_sdk: Pushed updates at 1775240401 — includes Python + TS samples, redirect fixes, and a small migration blurb. cc @maya_docs for final copy.

maya_docs: Reviewing now. Quick ask: can we add a short example command to detect affected projects? A grep like `git grep "embeddings.stream(" -- "src/**"` would be useful in the migration guide.

kevin_sdk: Added that grep snippet in the PR description.

release-bot: Deploy checklist updated. After linkchecker passes, relnotes draft will be moved into the release branch. :white_check_mark:

maya_docs: Thanks everyone — I'll finalize the release blurb and ping #marketing for the announcement copy. We'll include the known-issues bullet and the quick migration snippet in the docs release notes. "Good to merge" once sam confirms linkchecker. :rocket:
